decision_rule: Ask for municipality GPS landmark and road name before dispatching unless an emergency hotline is needed.
examples: pothole on main road; broken bridge no town
notes: Location is the main resolver for local versus national ownership.

decision_rule: Route ordinary local street potholes and neighborhood paving to the resolved municipality.
examples: pothole in Tripoli neighborhood street; local road damaged in Zahle
notes: Do not escalate to MPWT unless national/classified route is indicated.

decision_rule: Route to MPWT when national/classified/highway evidence is present; keep HITL if road class is ambiguous.
examples: autostrade pothole; tari2 dawli broken; highway barrier missing
notes: MPWT is ministry road actor; local road ambiguity remains.

decision_rule: Bridge damage routes to MPWT for asset ownership review and CD if collapse or rescue danger is present.
examples: bridge crack; jisr damaged; overpass unsafe
notes: Bridge ownership may still need project/local confirmation.

decision_rule: Route ordinary sidewalks to municipality; ask HITL if tied to highway works or MPWT asset.
examples: broken sidewalk in Jounieh; raseef damaged

decision_rule: Route local blockage to municipality but escalate to MPWT for main/classified route and CD for immediate danger.
examples: rocks blocking road; tree blocking street; landslide after rain
notes: HITL checks class danger and emergency status.

decision_rule: Local road snow issues start with municipality; national route closure requires MPWT and rescue danger requires CD.
examples: snow closed village road; highway icy and blocked
notes: No generic clearance SLA is published in this shard.

decision_rule: Use CDR only for explicit CDR/reconstruction/project-site signals or verified project owner evidence.
examples: CDR project worksite unsafe; contractor left excavation
notes: CDR is project-owner escalation not daily road maintenance.

decision_rule: Ask who owns the worksite or project before selecting entity.
examples: werche on road unsafe; contractor left hole
notes: Owner ambiguity is expected and should not auto-route.
